The `threads continue` options below are from @ampcode/cli 0.0.1795075234-g7a71f0
`amp threads continue --help` (retrieved 2026-11-19).

Run amp to start the Amp CLI. Without any arguments, it runs in interactive mode.
To see more of what the CLI can do, run amp --help.
amp --executor local
amp --executor orb
amp --executor runner:grandmas-garage-server

Run amp threads continue T-… to attach the CLI to a thread.
amp threads continue T-…

Usage: amp threads continue [options] [threads...]

Continue an existing thread by resuming the conversation. Each thread can be a thread URL or ID. By default, interactive mode shows a picker. Use --last to continue the last thread for this terminal and mode in this checkout, falling back to the last thread in this checkout.

  --last
      Continue the last thread in this checkout for the current mode, preferring this terminal
  --pick
      Pick a thread interactively from a list (DEPRECATED: picker is now the default)

Source: https://ampcode.com/docs/markdown/tools
Amp does not ask for approval before running tools.
Use a custom plugin to control tool use.
